sn21.11:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.11:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahā kappino yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā.
sn21.11:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahākappinaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
sn21.11:1.5: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etaṃ bhikkhuṃ āgacchantaṃ odātaṃ tanukaṃ tuṅganāsikanti.
sn21.11:1.7: eso kho bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo
sn21.11:1.8: na ca sā samāpatti( sulabharūpā yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā
sn21.11:1.9: yassa catthāya kula puttā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahma cariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
sn21.11:2.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
